identificationModule.briefTitle: Tislelizumab Combined With Fruquintinib for Metastatic pMMR/MSS Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: PD-1 Antibody (Tislelizumab) Combined With VEGFR 1/2/3 Inhibitor (Fruquintinib) for ARID1A-mutated Metastatic pMMR/MSS Colorectal Cancer: an Open-label, Multi-center, Phase II Clinical Trial

statusModule.whyStopped: Due to slow patient recruiting. No patients were enrolled 12 months after study initiation.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label phase II study, with the aim of investigating the efficacy and safety of Tislelizumab + Fruquintinib combination therapy in ARID1A-mutated pMMR/MSS metastatic colorectal cancer who have been treated with standard chemotherapy that includes fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan. Patients with hypermutated CRC that carries POLE/POLD1 mutations cannot be included.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this open-label phase II study, patients with ARID1A-mutated pMMR/MSS metastatic colorectal cancer who have been treated with standard chemotherapy that includes fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan, will be scheduled for Tislelizumab (200mg ivdrip Q3W day1) + Fruquintinib (5mg/day Q3W day1-14) until intolerable toxicity, disease progression or death. Primary endpoint of this study is ORR and secondary endpoints are OS, PFS, DCR and safety.

armGroups.label: patients with mCRC
armGroups.description: Tislelizumab 200mg ivdrip every 3 weeks; Fruquintinib 5mg qd day 1-14, every 3 weeks

interventions.name: Tislelizumab & Fruquintinib
interventions.description: combinational treatment of Tislelizumab and Fruquintinib until PD, intolerable toxicity, death or withdrawal of informed consent

primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients with a confirmed complete response or partial response

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as the time from enrollment to the first documented progressive disease (PD) or death due to any cause, whichever occurred first.
OS is defined as the time from enrollment to death due to any cause.
The proportion of patients with a best overall response of confirmed complete or partial response, or stable disease (CR+ PR + SD).
Safety and tolerance evaluated by incidence, severity and outcomes of adverse events (AEs) and categorized by severity in accordance with the NCI CTC AE Version 5.0.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: until 60 days after last patient last study drug treatment
